hero.title: Center for Ecosystems Research & Development
hero.subtitle: CERD-UG is a Non Profit Organization which aims to promote an ecosystems and systems thinking approach in research, education and community engagement.

mission.title: Building a Sustainable Agro-Ecosystem
mission.description: The mission of CERD-UG is to provide all stakeholders with comprehensive and relevant knowledge and skills that contribute to the sustainability of the ecosystem, health, prosperity, food and nutritional security.
mission.goal: Our goal is to share our extensive experience in working with the agro-ecosystem to bring about development policy change, improve people's livelihoods, and contribute to achieving food and nutrition security, hence transforming the food system.
mission.pillar1: We provide agriculture services and support Organic Agriculture
mission.pillar2: We support small scale farmers to transition to Agroecology and transform the current food system

vision.quote: A sustainable agro-ecosystem in which every aspect of development is in harmony and complements each other.

impact.title: Changing lives together through sustainable farming
impact.description: We believe that we can change more lives together by promoting sustainable agricultural practices, engaging with local communities, and supporting local economies.
impact.vision: We strive to create a better future for everyone.

items.title: Biodiversity
items.description: Preserving the rich variety of plant, animal, and microbial life that sustains healthy ecosystems.

items.title: Ecological Balance
items.description: Maintaining the natural equilibrium of ecosystems to ensure long-term environmental health.

items.title: Animal Welfare
items.description: Ensuring humane and ethical treatment of animals in all farming and research activities.

items.title: Sustainability
items.description: Developing practices that meet today's needs without compromising future generations.

producers.title: We Are Producers For Local Markets
producers.description: Coffee, a beloved beverage enjoyed worldwide, is much more than just a morning pick-me-up. Originating from the beans of the Coffea plant, coffee is prepared in various ways, from the intense espresso shots to smooth, creamy lattes. Beyond its delicious taste, coffee is celebrated for its stimulating effects and its role in Uganda's agricultural economy and local communities.

recentWorks.title: Our Recent Works
recentWorks.subtitle: The current major development initiative is the Organic Products Market at Abaita Ababiri and Kitooro Municipality — providing physical space for organic farmers to sell their produce and promoting small holder farming for sustainable development and environmental conservation.

bottomCta.text: CERD UG creates impact by promoting Agroecology farming to protect the environment, support local communities, and improve livelihoods through training, sustainable practices, and quality Agroecology products.

hero.title: How our Journey Began
hero.description: CERD-UG was legally registered in 2018 after the Agro-ecology project in collaboration with the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences funded by Sida.

focus.title: From 2020 to 2024, CERD-UG operated nationally in Uganda
focus.description: Focusing on environmental and natural resource management with the primary goal of ecosystem conservation. The organization carried out several activities promoting sustainable practices and community involvement, aiming to align environmental health with community well-being.
focus.highlight: These efforts led to notable achievements in conservation and local development.

mission.quote: CERD-UG aims to co-create an ecosystems and systems thinking approach in research, education and community engagement.
mission.goal: Our goal is to apply our extensive experience in working with the agro-ecosystem to bring about development policy change, improve people's livelihoods, and contribute to achieving food and nutrition security.

programs.title: School Children & Youth
programs.description: We involve school children in Agroecological farming and understanding their environment. Young school children are taught to appreciate and respect nature, knowing that every component of the ecosystem affects and benefits the other for overall sustainability.

programs.title: Policy & Systems Thinking
programs.description: CERD-UG influences policymakers to engage in participatory and systems thinking approaches in development planning and management. We offer sustainable development values to communities in Uganda and the African Region, especially women and youth.
